title: Palindrome Detective
hints: Do not build a cleaned copy first (it works, but costs O(n) extra memory). Walk two indices inward from both ends instead.
Skip characters that are not alphanumeric on each side, then compare the two letters case-insensitively.
Cast to unsigned char before calling isalnum/tolower: std::isalnum(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch)).
almost_palindrome: on the first mismatch you have exactly two options - skip the left character or skip the right one. Check both with a helper that tests a range.
